cases.name: Alyssa Ann Longwell
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She graduated from Rivers Edge High School in Richland, Washington.  Alyssa had a huge heart and beautiful smile.  She loved her family, friends, and her son Tyson dearly.

Alyssa loved her son Tyson so much.  He was the light of her life, and she was very proud of the wonderful young man he was becoming.  They loved to play video games together, go to the movies, and just hang out.

Alyssa and her blue Pittie Rein were an inseparable pair.  She was her emotional support dog, and she rarely went anywhere without her.

Alyssa loved hiking with Rein, camping, kayaking, rafting on the Yakima, riding horses, going to the movies, and walking on the beach while visiting the oceanside. She enjoyed arts and crafts like crocheting, making pop sockets, doing puzzles, recently got into diamond art.  She was known for decorating her home for every holiday.  She loved to clean and organize, as many of her friends can attest to.  Alyssa loved to cook and bake.  She would much rather stay home and create a meal than go out to eat.  Creating cupcakes was a great passion and she always dreamed of being a pastry chef.  She enjoyed auto-cross racing and made a career for herself in the auto parts industry."
cases.narrative: Police say Potter pushed her from her car they were traveling in and shot her along the roadside, then opened fire on witnesses in another vehicle. She was beaten and forced out of her Kia Soul onto the snowy pavement of a two-lane road, nearly 130 miles from home. He then stopped the car and fired three shots at her on the ground, before turning the gun on two witnesses in another car, according to newly released court documents. The father and his 15-year-old daughter were out on the rural highway for a driving lesson when they saw the brutal attack, according to the documents. One shot went through their windshield, narrowly missing the girl, said police. Court documents show she's been shot in her neck, cheek, back, shoulder and shin and also had a broken arm, broken teeth and trauma to the back of her head.
